options.label: pip download/wheel cache
options.description: ~/.cache/pip. Uses `pip cache purge` when pip is installed.

options.label: uv cache
options.description: ~/.cache/uv. Uses `uv cache clean` when uv is installed.

options.label: Package cache and artifacts
options.description: ~/.cache/pypoetry/cache and artifacts. Virtualenvs are not touched.

options.label: Poetry virtualenvs — report only
options.description: ~/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs holds project environments. Remove them with `poetry env remove` inside each project.

options.label: npm package cache (_cacache)
options.description: Uses `npm cache clean --force` when npm is installed.

options.label: npm logs and npx cache
options.description: ~/.npm/_logs and ~/.npm/_npx.

options.label: Yarn classic cache
options.description: ~/.cache/yarn. Uses `yarn cache clean` when yarn is installed.

options.label: Yarn Berry global cache
options.description: ~/.yarn/berry/cache.

options.label: pnpm content store
options.description: ~/.local/share/pnpm/store. Uses `pnpm store prune` (removes only unreferenced packages) when pnpm is installed; the size shown is the whole store.

options.label: node-gyp headers and nvm download cache
options.description: ~/.cache/node-gyp and ~/.nvm/.cache.

options.label: Go build cache
options.description: GOCACHE (~/.cache/go-build). Uses `go clean -cache` when go is installed.

options.label: Go module cache
options.description: GOMODCACHE (~/go/pkg/mod). Files are read-only, so only `go clean -modcache` is used. Modules re-download on next build.

options.label: Registry cache and sources
options.description: ~/.cargo/registry/cache and registry/src. Re-downloaded on next build.

options.label: Git dependency checkouts
options.description: ~/.cargo/git/checkouts and git/db. Git dependencies are cloned again.

options.label: Gradle caches
options.description: ~/.gradle/caches. Runs `gradle --stop` first when gradle is installed. Dependencies re-download on next build.

options.label: Gradle daemon logs
options.description: ~/.gradle/daemon/<version>/*.log.

options.label: Old Gradle wrapper distributions
options.description: ~/.gradle/wrapper/dists; the two most recently used are kept.

options.label: Local repository
options.description: ~/.m2/repository, one row per top-level group. Locally installed SNAPSHOT artifacts are lost.

options.label: NuGet HTTP cache
options.description: ~/.local/share/NuGet/http-cache and v3-cache.

options.label: Global packages folder
options.description: ~/.nuget/packages. Uses `dotnet nuget locals all --clear` (clears all NuGet caches) when dotnet is installed. Packages re-download on next restore.

options.label: Package cache (pkgs)
options.description: Uses `conda clean --all -y` when conda is installed (never --force-pkgs-dirs).

options.label: Downloaded model / dataset
options.description: One row per cached repository in the hub cache (respects HF_HOME / HF_HUB_CACHE). Re-downloads can be many GB.

options.label: Xet chunk cache
options.description: {HF_HOME}/xet.

options.label: Compiled kernels
options.description: ~/.cache/torch/kernels.

options.label: Torch Hub downloads
options.description: ~/.cache/torch/hub; models re-download.

options.label: Caches of older IDE versions
options.description: ~/.cache/JetBrains/<Product><version> for versions older than the newest per product.

options.label: Caches of the current IDE version
options.description: Indexes are rebuilt on next start (can take a while).

options.label: Settings and plugins of older IDE versions
options.description: ~/.local/share/JetBrains and ~/.config/JetBrains folders for versions older than the newest per product.

options.label: Composer cache
options.description: ~/.cache/composer. Uses `composer clear-cache` when installed.

options.label: Old gem versions
options.description: Runs `gem cleanup` (removes superseded versions of installed gems). Only available when gem is installed.

options.label: Bundler caches
options.description: ~/.bundle/cache and ~/.cache/bundle.

options.label: Homebrew download cache
options.description: ~/.cache/Homebrew. Uses `brew cleanup --prune=all` when brew is installed.

options.label: Electron download caches
options.description: ~/.cache/electron and ~/.cache/electron-builder.

options.label: Downloaded test browsers
options.description: ~/.cache/ms-playwright, ~/.cache/puppeteer and ~/.cache/Cypress. Re-downloaded by the next install.

options.label: Android tools cache
options.description: ~/.android/cache.

options.label: Virtual device
options.description: An emulator image with its installed apps and data. Lost permanently.

options.label: Emulator system images
options.description: ~/Android/Sdk/system-images/<api>. Re-download with the SDK manager.

options.label: Unity cache
options.description: ~/.cache/unity3d.

options.label: Asset Store downloads
options.description: ~/.local/share/unity3d/Asset Store-5.x; packages re-download.
